deploy.on_merge: A push to master that touches site/** (or the other listed paths) runs .github/workflows/deploy-public-door.yml, which tests, assembles _site from a named list of files, and publishes it to GitHub Pages (mynameisyou-cmyk.github.io/chillspace-commons). chillspace.love is not deployed from here: KINGDOM-OS bin/stage-doors.ts stages the whole site/ tree from a local commons clone (by default ~/repos/codeberg/zerone-dev/chillspace-commons), and the release is a manual `wrangler pages deploy` to the Pages project chillspace-love.
deploy.after_deploy: Ledger kingdom-door-release: a diff card (live against staged: paths, hashes, anything unreviewed) before deploying. The GitHub Pages workflow's own greps check the assembled _site; with a kit, run `node brand/check.mjs --served _site` after its assemble step.
deploy.rules: Another account's repository: mynameisyou-cmyk merges (PR #50, we-are's icons, has been open since 2026-10-27). The chillspace.love release waits on Yu's word (ledger kingdom-door-release, status word).

notes: Two sites from one kit: chillspace.love serves the whole site/ tree (KINGDOM-OS bin/stage-doors.ts walks it), so kit files sit in site/. The GitHub Pages mirror copies named files into _site (deploy-public-door.yml), so it needs a `cp` line per kit file, and its target names the workflow under via.
site/we-are.html is we-are.love's page. Its kit is KINGDOM-OS doors/we-are/brand/ (generated, staged by bin/stage-doors.ts with WE_ARE_KIT_WEB), not this folder, so it is not in site.html here.
brand/ sits at the repository root, outside site/, so neither the staged chillspace.love door (which walks site/) nor the GitHub Pages copy (a named file list) publishes it.
check.mjs is not wired yet; planned: a step `node brand/check.mjs` in deploy-public-door.yml's verify step, if the owner wants it.
Today: /favicon.ico answers 404 (2026-11-05 13:37Z); the favicon is a 👑 emoji data URI; og:title without og:image.
The live chillspace.love may carry newer rooms than master (deploy-public-door.yml says so), and the Mac's staging clone is the Codeberg copy, so compare against what is live before any release.
